propositions: Step-budget exhaustion raises LLMRunnerError which does not match the existing except UnretryableOutputError clause in CompletionAgentStep.run, preventing bounded recovery from engaging
LLMRunnerError is a strict ancestor of UnretryableOutputError in the exception hierarchy, so catch blocks targeting UnretryableOutputError never intercept budget exhaustion errors
Bounded completion recovery isolates criteria in fresh agentic history and must be reachable for budget exhaustion to avoid undiagnosed step failures
A new LLMBudgetExhaustedError subclass of LLMRunnerError must be raised by interpret_failure's budget branch to enable type-based routing independent of diagnostic shape sniffing
CompletionAgentStep.run must extend its exception handling to catch LLMBudgetExhaustedError and route it to _recover, preserving failure_diagnostic for downstream error reporting
